provenance_label: Live run on a Civo cluster

issue.symptom: POST /api/checkout returns HTTP 500 for orders of 30 or more units of one item; smaller orders work.

observations.text: Large orders (qty >= 30) crash in bulk_rate because BULK_TIERS has only 3 entries and qty//10 exceeds index 2.
evidence: logs storefront-d64f6b7b7-rfbj4 traceback IndexError at pricing.py:43 BULK_TIERS[qty // 10]
docs/pricing.md rule 2: 20 or more units 10% with no upper limit

hypotheses.text: Root cause is an off-by-one/out-of-range lookup in bulk_rate; should cap the tier index at 2 so 20+ units get 10% with no upper limit.

agent_conclusion.root_cause: bulk_rate indexed BULK_TIERS with qty // 10 without capping; quantities of 20+ (e.g. 30 mugs) produced index 3, out of range, causing an unhandled IndexError and HTTP 500.
agent_conclusion.summary: Fixed bulk_rate to cap the tier index at the top 10% tier, added a regression test for 30-unit orders, rebuilt and deployed the storefront image, and verified the checkout now returns 200 with the expected total.
evidence: pod logs: IndexError at storefront/pricing.py:43 BULK_TIERS[qty // 10]
http_check after deploy: POST /api/checkout qty=30 -> 200 total 349.92
